perm.subtitle: Lumi asks for as little as possible. Here's every permission in plain language.
perm.notificationsWhy: For reminders you choose and timer alerts. All scheduled on your phone; no server sends them.
perm.usageWhy: To show your screen time and know when a limited app opens. Lumi sees app names and times only, never what's inside apps. Stays on your phone.
perm.overlayWhy: So the pause screen can appear on top of an app you chose to limit.
perm.grayscaleWhy: Only if you set it up from a computer, so Lumi can switch grayscale on at bedtime. Without it, you can turn grayscale on yourself.
perm.photosWhy: Only when you add screenshots to your evidence log, using your phone's photo picker. Lumi can't see your other photos.
perm.biometricsWhy: Only if you turn on App lock. Your fingerprint or face never leaves your phone; the phone just tells Lumi yes or no.
perm.networkWhy: Only for the optional peer space, anonymous notes and events. Your personal data is never uploaded.
perm.footer: You can change any permission in your phone's settings at any time. Lumi keeps working without them.
perm.iosNote: On iPhone, screen-time and pause-screen permissions aren't available to apps like Lumi. Everything else works.

privacy.subtitle: Plain-language answers about your data.
privacy.promise1: Your moods, journal, sleep, screen time and evidence log stay on this phone.
privacy.promise2: No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no selling data. Ever.
privacy.promise3: Nobody can monitor you through Lumi: not staff, parents or friends.
privacy.promise4: Cloud features are optional, anonymous and need your consent.
privacy.promise5: You can export or delete everything at any time.
privacy.rowHabits: Screen time, limits, gaming and focus
privacy.rowCommunity: Peer posts, replies and anonymous notes
privacy.cloudAnon: Cloud (Firebase), with an anonymous ID, only if you agree
privacy.cloudPublic: Cloud, read-only. Your interest is saved only on this phone
privacy.consentGiven: On. Turn off to withdraw and delete your cloud posts and notes
privacy.consentNotGiven: Off. Nothing is stored in the cloud
privacy.noCloud: Cloud features aren't set up in this version, so nothing ever leaves your phone.
privacy.demoNoCloud: In demo mode nothing is uploaded.
privacy.anonId: Your anonymous ID (only needed if you help run the app as staff)
privacy.exportUnavailable: Sharing isn't available on this device.
privacy.deleteCloud: Delete my cloud posts and notes
privacy.deleteAllBody: This deletes all your Lumi data from this phone, and your posts and notes from the cloud. It can't be undone. You may want to export first.
privacy.deletedLocalOnly: Deleted from this phone. We couldn't reach the cloud; try deleting cloud data again when you're online.
privacy.deleteNote: Uninstalling Lumi also deletes everything on this phone. Cloud posts can't be linked back to you after that.
privacy.withdrawBody: Your posts, replies and anonymous notes will be deleted from the cloud, and community features will be switched off.
privacy.withdrawn: Done. Your cloud data has been deleted.
privacy.cloudDeleteFailed: We couldn't reach the cloud. Please try again when you're online.

about.intro: Lumi helps young people build a healthier relationship with their phones, games and social media, and look after their mental wellbeing. It focuses on the reasons we get stuck, not just screen time.
about.notTherapistBody: Lumi doesn't diagnose, treat or give medical advice, and it can't respond in an emergency. If you're struggling, please talk to someone you trust, a doctor, or a helpline.
about.design1: Private by default: your personal data stays on your phone.
about.design2: Kind by design: no shaming, no leaderboards, kind restarts.
about.design3: No monitoring: nobody can watch what you do in Lumi.
about.design4: Real people first: help is always one tap away.
about.design5: Accessible: works with screen readers, large text and dark mode.
about.limitsBody: Real screen-time tracking and pause screens only work on Android with the full app. On iPhone and the web, Lumi uses check-ins and in-app tools instead. Keyword checks for distress can miss things or over-trigger, so Lumi always responds with a kind offer of help, never an alarm.
about.credits: Icons: Ionicons and Material Design Icons (open source). Built with React Native, Expo and Firebase.
